source: LIVE read-only pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef via Supabase connector
selection: nspname='pg_catalog' and prokind='f' and lanname in ('c','internal')
semantic_review_scope: Full visible SQL declaration, identity, arguments/return, native symbol, security mode, volatility/parallel/leakproof/strict, SQL-level roles, and operational intent of each provider-owned function. Native binary bodies, execution-time privilege checks and hosted API exposure not certified.

findings.description: 240 core pg_catalog declarations support numeric, OID, geometric, locking, session, backup, replication, metadata and catalog internals. No safe application-level removal or reproducible declaration defect.

Advisory-lock and some management/replication declarations have client SQL EXECUTE grants. Both anon and authenticated are NOLOGIN, non-superuser, non-replication, non-BYPASSRLS and lack pg_signal_backend and pg_monitor membership; native privilege checks and hosted exposure remain unverified, no live invocations.
No full C/internal compiled implementation provided; only full available SQL declaration bodies reviewed.
